title: Approve a north-star composition for Priti Travels Hub
question: Pick one of the three hero + quick-search compositions (or tell us what to carry forward, combine, or adjust) before we lock the spatial spec and start coding.

options.label: Comp 1 — Balanced Cinema Split
options.thesis: Classic documentary split: monumental UDAIPUR stack left, equal-height glass state cards with region subtitles right, overlapping dark-glass Quick Search Bar.
options.viewport: Left UDAIPUR condensed display + 2-line copy + bookmark/Discover Location; right 4 equal portrait cards with subtitles; centered glass search dock.
options.risk: Most balanced and familiar layout; less editorial typography contrast without an italic serif subhead.

options.label: Comp 2 — Serif-Paired Documentary Slate
options.thesis: Pairs monumental condensed UDAIPUR with Playfair Display italic ('City of Dawn & Marble'), saffron active card border, and Popular Destinations peeking into #F7F3EC.
options.viewport: Left UDAIPUR + italic serif subtitle + pin label; right state card rail with active saffron rim; anchored search dock above Popular Destinations.
options.risk: Slightly denser left column at smaller laptop heights if description wraps past 2 lines.

options.label: Comp 3 — Hairline & Stepped Depth Deck
options.thesis: Vertical saffron editorial hairline framing the left hero block paired with a stepped depth cascade of tall destination cards on the right.
options.viewport: Hairline-anchored UDAIPUR left; staggered descending-height card deck right; compact segmented Quick Search Bar overlapping #F7F3EC.
options.risk: Stepped card heights require tighter responsive breakpoints on tablet/mobile.
